import QleisliKernel

/-! Current regression successor to the immutable v0.2.5 factoring fixture.
Historical literal helper bodies are compared with each other, not with the
current prepared ordinary-rule fees. Current helper equations and successful
checking facts are separate below. No accepted handle or semantic rule is added.
See README.md for exact historical source/hash bindings and validation limits.
Copyright 2026 Qleisli Project Contributors.
Historical snapshots: Copyright 2026 Masahiko G. Yamada.
SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 -/

namespace QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.PreparedFixtureReview
open Artifact Conditional

namespace HistoricalBefore
def localCheck (artifact : Artifact) (index remaining : Nat) : Except Error Local :=
  match artifact.proofs[index]? with
  | none => .error .invalidIr
  | some proof =>
    if proof.rule == .finite then
      match Finite.inspect artifact index remaining with
      | .error error => .error error
      | .ok pending => .ok (.finite pending)
    else
      match Rule.check artifact index remaining with
      | .error error => .error error
      | .ok checked => .ok (.ordinary checked)

def typedLocalCheck (artifact : Artifact) (_context : TypedRule.Context artifact) (index remaining : Nat) : Except Error Local :=
  match artifact.proofs[index]? with
  | none => .error .invalidIr
  | some proof =>
    if proof.rule == .finite then
      match Finite.inspect artifact index remaining with
      | .error error => .error error
      | .ok pending => .ok (.finite pending)
    else
      match TypedRule.check artifact index remaining with
      | .error error => .error error
      | .ok checked => .ok (.ordinary checked)

def step (artifact : Artifact) (state : Conditional.State) (index : Nat) : Except Failure Conditional.State :=
  if state.cache[index]? != some false then .error ⟨.invalidIr,some ⟨.proof,index⟩⟩ else
  match artifact.proofs[index]? with
  | none => .error ⟨.invalidIr,some ⟨.proof,index⟩⟩
  | some proof =>
    let used := state.visits + 4 + 4 * proof.premises.size
    if used > 2000000 then .error ⟨.limit,some ⟨.proof,index⟩⟩ else
    if !(proof.premises.all (fun child => state.cache[child]? == some true)) then
      .error ⟨.contract,some ⟨.proof,index⟩⟩
    else match localCheck artifact index (2000000 - used) with
      | .error error => .error ⟨error,some ⟨.proof,index⟩⟩
      | .ok checked =>
        let total := used + checked.visits
        if total > 2000000 then .error ⟨.limit,some ⟨.proof,index⟩⟩
        else .ok ⟨state.cache.setIfInBounds index true,state.requests ++ checked.requests,
          total,state.proofs+1⟩

def typedStep (artifact : Artifact) (context : TypedRule.Context artifact) (state : Conditional.State) (index : Nat) : Except Failure Conditional.State :=
  if state.cache[index]? != some false then .error ⟨.invalidIr,some ⟨.proof,index⟩⟩ else
  match artifact.proofs[index]? with
  | none => .error ⟨.invalidIr,some ⟨.proof,index⟩⟩
  | some proof =>
    let used := state.visits + 4 + 4 * proof.premises.size
    if used > 2000000 then .error ⟨.limit,some ⟨.proof,index⟩⟩ else
    if !(proof.premises.all (fun child => state.cache[child]? == some true)) then
      .error ⟨.contract,some ⟨.proof,index⟩⟩
    else match typedLocalCheck artifact context index (2000000 - used) with
      | .error error => .error ⟨error,some ⟨.proof,index⟩⟩
      | .ok checked =>
        let total := used + checked.visits
        if total > 2000000 then .error ⟨.limit,some ⟨.proof,index⟩⟩
        else .ok ⟨state.cache.setIfInBounds index true,state.requests ++ checked.requests,
          total,state.proofs+1⟩

def scan (artifact : Artifact) (order : List Nat) (state : Conditional.State) : Except Failure Conditional.State :=
  order.foldlM (step artifact) state

def typedScan (artifact : Artifact) (context : TypedRule.Context artifact) (order : List Nat) (state : Conditional.State) : Except Failure Conditional.State :=
  order.foldlM (typedStep artifact context) state

def checkAll (artifact : Artifact) (order : Array Nat) : Except Failure Pending :=
  match typing : ContractTyping.checkAll artifact order with
  | .error failure => .error failure
  | .ok typed =>
    let start := typed.totalVisits + 6 * (order.size + artifact.proofs.size)
    if start > 2000000 then .error ⟨.limit,none⟩ else
    match typedScan artifact (TypedRule.context_of_checkAll artifact order typed typing)
        (Derivation.proofOrder artifact order)
        ⟨Array.replicate artifact.proofs.size false,#[],start,0⟩ with
    | .error failure => .error failure
    | .ok state =>
      if state.visits > 2000000 then .error ⟨.limit,none⟩ else
      if !state.cache.all id || state.cache[artifact.entry.proof]? != some true then
        .error ⟨.contract,some ⟨.proof,artifact.entry.proof⟩⟩
      else .ok ⟨typed,state⟩

end HistoricalBefore

namespace HistoricalAfter
private def localCheckWith (artifact : Artifact)
    (ordinary : Nat → Nat → Except Error Rule.Checked) (index remaining : Nat) : Except Error Local :=
  match artifact.proofs[index]? with
  | none => .error .invalidIr
  | some proof =>
    if proof.rule == .finite then
      match Finite.inspect artifact index remaining with
      | .error error => .error error
      | .ok pending => .ok (.finite pending)
    else
      match ordinary index remaining with
      | .error error => .error error
      | .ok checked => .ok (.ordinary checked)

def localCheck (artifact : Artifact) (index remaining : Nat) : Except Error Local :=
  localCheckWith artifact (Rule.check artifact) index remaining

def typedLocalCheck (artifact : Artifact) (_context : TypedRule.Context artifact) (index remaining : Nat) : Except Error Local :=
  localCheckWith artifact (TypedRule.check artifact) index remaining

private def stepWith (artifact : Artifact)
    (checker : Nat → Nat → Except Error Local) (state : State) (index : Nat) : Except Failure State :=
  if state.cache[index]? != some false then .error ⟨.invalidIr,some ⟨.proof,index⟩⟩ else
  match artifact.proofs[index]? with
  | none => .error ⟨.invalidIr,some ⟨.proof,index⟩⟩
  | some proof =>
    let used := state.visits + 4 + 4 * proof.premises.size
    if used > Limits.maxVisits then .error ⟨.limit,some ⟨.proof,index⟩⟩ else
    if !(proof.premises.all (fun child => state.cache[child]? == some true)) then
      .error ⟨.contract,some ⟨.proof,index⟩⟩
    else match checker index (Limits.maxVisits - used) with
      | .error error => .error ⟨error,some ⟨.proof,index⟩⟩
      | .ok checked =>
        let total := used + checked.visits
        if total > Limits.maxVisits then .error ⟨.limit,some ⟨.proof,index⟩⟩
        else .ok ⟨state.cache.setIfInBounds index true,state.requests ++ checked.requests,
          total,state.proofs+1⟩

def step (artifact : Artifact) (state : State) (index : Nat) : Except Failure State :=
  stepWith artifact (localCheck artifact) state index

def typedStep (artifact : Artifact) (context : TypedRule.Context artifact) (state : State) (index : Nat) : Except Failure State :=
  stepWith artifact (typedLocalCheck artifact context) state index

def scan (artifact : Artifact) (order : List Nat) (state : State) : Except Failure State :=
  order.foldlM (step artifact) state

def typedScan (artifact : Artifact) (context : TypedRule.Context artifact) (order : List Nat) (state : State) : Except Failure State :=
  order.foldlM (typedStep artifact context) state

def checkAll (artifact : Artifact) (order : Array Nat) : Except Failure Pending :=
  match typing : ContractTyping.checkAll artifact order with
  | .error failure => .error failure
  | .ok typed =>
    let start := typed.totalVisits + 6 * (order.size + artifact.proofs.size)
    if start > Limits.maxVisits then .error ⟨.limit,none⟩ else
    match typedScan artifact (TypedRule.context_of_checkAll artifact order typed typing)
        (Derivation.proofOrder artifact order)
        ⟨Array.replicate artifact.proofs.size false,#[],start,0⟩ with
    | .error failure => .error failure
    | .ok state =>
      if state.visits > Limits.maxVisits then .error ⟨.limit,none⟩ else
      if !state.cache.all id || state.cache[artifact.entry.proof]? != some true then
        .error ⟨.contract,some ⟨.proof,artifact.entry.proof⟩⟩
      else .ok ⟨typed,state⟩

end HistoricalAfter

-- Retain all seven historical literal factoring equations. Imported subordinate
-- checks are shared; this is not old/current complete native or binary equality.
theorem historical_localCheck_factoring :
    HistoricalBefore.localCheck = HistoricalAfter.localCheck := rfl

theorem historical_typedLocalCheck_factoring :
    HistoricalBefore.typedLocalCheck = HistoricalAfter.typedLocalCheck := rfl

theorem historical_step_factoring :
    HistoricalBefore.step = HistoricalAfter.step := rfl

theorem historical_typedStep_factoring :
    HistoricalBefore.typedStep = HistoricalAfter.typedStep := rfl

theorem historical_scan_factoring :
    HistoricalBefore.scan = HistoricalAfter.scan := rfl

theorem historical_typedScan_factoring :
    HistoricalBefore.typedScan = HistoricalAfter.typedScan := rfl

theorem historical_checkAll_factoring :
    HistoricalBefore.checkAll = HistoricalAfter.checkAll := rfl

namespace CurrentBodies
private def localCheckWith (artifact : Artifact)
    (ordinary : Nat → Nat → Except Error Rule.Checked) (index remaining : Nat) : Except Error Local :=
  match artifact.proofs[index]? with
  | none => .error .invalidIr
  | some proof =>
    if proof.rule == .finite then
      match Finite.inspect artifact index remaining with
      | .error error => .error error
      | .ok pending => .ok (.finite pending)
    else
      match ordinary index remaining with
      | .error error => .error error
      | .ok checked => .ok (.ordinary checked)

def localCheck (artifact : Artifact) (index remaining : Nat) : Except Error Local :=
  localCheckWith artifact (Rule.check artifact) index remaining

def typedLocalCheck (artifact : Artifact) (context : TypedRule.PreparedContext artifact) (index remaining : Nat) : Except Error Local :=
  localCheckWith artifact (TypedRule.checkPrepared artifact context) index remaining

private def stepWith (artifact : Artifact)
    (checker : Nat → Nat → Except Error Local) (state : State) (index : Nat) : Except Failure State :=
  if state.cache[index]? != some false then .error ⟨.invalidIr,some ⟨.proof,index⟩⟩ else
  match artifact.proofs[index]? with
  | none => .error ⟨.invalidIr,some ⟨.proof,index⟩⟩
  | some proof =>
    let used := state.visits + 4 + 4 * proof.premises.size
    if used > Limits.maxVisits then .error ⟨.limit,some ⟨.proof,index⟩⟩ else
    if !(proof.premises.all (fun child => state.cache[child]? == some true)) then
      .error ⟨.contract,some ⟨.proof,index⟩⟩
    else match checker index (Limits.maxVisits - used) with
      | .error error => .error ⟨error,some ⟨.proof,index⟩⟩
      | .ok checked =>
        let total := used + checked.visits
        if total > Limits.maxVisits then .error ⟨.limit,some ⟨.proof,index⟩⟩
        else .ok ⟨state.cache.setIfInBounds index true,state.requests ++ checked.requests,
          total,state.proofs+1⟩

def step (artifact : Artifact) (state : State) (index : Nat) : Except Failure State :=
  stepWith artifact (localCheck artifact) state index

def typedStep (artifact : Artifact) (context : TypedRule.PreparedContext artifact) (state : State) (index : Nat) : Except Failure State :=
  stepWith artifact (typedLocalCheck artifact context) state index

def scan (artifact : Artifact) (order : List Nat) (state : State) : Except Failure State :=
  order.foldlM (step artifact) state

def typedScan (artifact : Artifact) (context : TypedRule.PreparedContext artifact) (order : List Nat) (state : State) : Except Failure State :=
  order.foldlM (typedStep artifact context) state

def checkAll (artifact : Artifact) (order : Array Nat) : Except Failure Pending :=
  match typing : ContractTyping.checkAll artifact order with
  | .error failure => .error failure
  | .ok typed =>
    let start := typed.totalVisits + 6 * (order.size + artifact.proofs.size)
    if start > Limits.maxVisits then .error ⟨.limit,none⟩ else
    match typedScan artifact (TypedRule.preparedContext_of_checkAll artifact order typed typing)
        (Derivation.proofOrder artifact order)
        ⟨Array.replicate artifact.proofs.size false,#[],start,0⟩ with
    | .error failure => .error failure
    | .ok state =>
      if state.visits > Limits.maxVisits then .error ⟨.limit,none⟩ else
      if !state.cache.all id || state.cache[artifact.entry.proof]? != some true then
        .error ⟨.contract,some ⟨.proof,artifact.entry.proof⟩⟩
      else .ok ⟨typed,state⟩

end CurrentBodies

-- Pin actual current complete states, request order, failures and paid fees.
theorem current_localCheck_equation :
    CurrentBodies.localCheck = Conditional.localCheck := rfl

theorem current_typedLocalCheck_equation :
    CurrentBodies.typedLocalCheck = Conditional.typedLocalCheck := rfl

theorem current_step_equation :
    CurrentBodies.step = Conditional.step := rfl

theorem current_typedStep_equation :
    CurrentBodies.typedStep = Conditional.typedStep := rfl

theorem current_scan_equation :
    CurrentBodies.scan = Conditional.scan := rfl

theorem current_typedScan_equation :
    CurrentBodies.typedScan = Conditional.typedScan := rfl

theorem current_checkAll_equation :
    CurrentBodies.checkAll = Conditional.checkAll := rfl

-- The stronger context comes from this artifact's actual complete typing pass.
theorem current_context_from_actual_typing (artifact : Artifact) (order : Array Nat)
    (typed : ContractTyping.Typed)
    (accepted : ContractTyping.checkAll artifact order = .ok typed) :
    TypedRule.PreparedContext artifact :=
  TypedRule.preparedContext_of_checkAll artifact order typed accepted

-- Bind the original predicate to the actual indexed proof and ordered premises.
theorem current_indexed_ordinary_predicate (artifact : Artifact) (order : Array Nat)
    (typed : ContractTyping.Typed)
    (accepted : ContractTyping.checkAll artifact order = .ok typed)
    (index : Nat) (proof : Proof) (found : artifact.proofs[index]? = some proof) :
    TypedRule.preparedOrdinary artifact proof = TypedRule.ordinary artifact proof :=
  TypedRule.preparedOrdinary_eq artifact
    (current_context_from_actual_typing artifact order typed accepted) index proof found

-- Retain the same actual finite call, errors, visits and complete pending request.
theorem current_finite_leaf_unchanged (artifact : Artifact)
    (context : TypedRule.PreparedContext artifact) (index remaining : Nat)
    (proof : Proof) (found : artifact.proofs[index]? = some proof)
    (finite : proof.rule = .finite) :
    CurrentBodies.typedLocalCheck artifact context index remaining =
      HistoricalBefore.typedLocalCheck artifact context.typed index remaining := by
  simp [CurrentBodies.typedLocalCheck,CurrentBodies.localCheckWith,
    HistoricalBefore.typedLocalCheck,found,finite]

-- Prepared ordinary success still proves the original Rule.Matches predicate.
theorem current_prepared_rule_conditions (artifact : Artifact)
    (context : TypedRule.PreparedContext artifact) (index remaining : Nat)
    (checked : Rule.Checked)
    (accepted : TypedRule.checkPrepared artifact context index remaining = .ok checked) :
    checked.visits ≤ remaining ∧ remaining ≤ 2000000 ∧ Rule.Matches artifact index :=
  TypedRule.checkPrepared_conditions artifact context index remaining checked accepted

-- Real finite obligations remain; no leaf predicate is replaced by True.
-- Historical/current total visits and near-limit acceptance need not be equal.
theorem current_complete_conditions (artifact : Artifact) (order : Array Nat)
    (pending : Pending) (accepted : CurrentBodies.checkAll artifact order = .ok pending) :
    ContractTyping.checkAll artifact order = .ok pending.typed ∧
    pending.state.visits ≤ 2000000 ∧ Invariant artifact pending.state ∧
    RequestsBound artifact pending.state.requests ∧
    ∀ finite : Finite.Request → Prop,
      (∀ request ∈ pending.state.requests.toList, finite request) →
      Derives artifact finite artifact.entry.proof := by
  rw [current_checkAll_equation] at accepted
  exact Conditional.checkAll_conditions artifact order pending accepted

end QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.PreparedFixtureReview

-- Generated names remain present with the current PreparedContext interface.
#check QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.Conditional.scan.eq_1
#check QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.Conditional.typedScan.eq_1
#check QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.Conditional.typedLocalCheck.congr_simp
#check QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.Conditional.typedStep.congr_simp

-- Fixed numerical ceilings and complete ordered-field definitions remain checked.
example : QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.Limits.maxVisits = 2000000 := rfl
example : QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.Limits.maxNodes = 100000 := rfl
example : QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.Limits.maxReferences = 1000000 := rfl
example : QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.Limits.maxDepth = 256 := rfl
example : QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.Limits.maxPayloadBytes = 16777216 := rfl
example (side : QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.Artifact.Side) :
    QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.Artifact.sideFields side =
      1 + side.quantum.foldl (fun n p => n + 3 + 2*p.basis.size + p.axes.size) 0 +
        side.classical.foldl (fun n p => n + 2 + 2*p.basis.size) 0 := rfl
example : QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.TypedRule.sideFields =
    QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.Artifact.sideFields := rfl
